title: David Grusch testimony and ICIG report

tellings.quote: Wait a second. Didn't David Grusch raise his hand and say that we have been generationally exploiting non-human technology hand to God and to country

plain: Jeremy Corbell, a filmmaker who makes UFO documentaries, spoke with the podcast host Jesse Michels in 2026 and pointed back to David Grusch, a former US intelligence officer who came forward as a whistleblower in Washington. Corbell says Grusch raised his hand and swore, "hand to God and to country," that the United States has been exploiting non-human technology for generations. He links this to a report from the ICIG, the inspector general who watches over the US spy agencies, and he also names Christopher Fox and Chuck McCullough. If it were true, the government would have been holding technology not made by people for decades.
